support_olivia: FYI Tenant Alpha just escalated — their trace view is missing spans for a set of 5xx requests that show up in API logs. customer says request IDs exist in logs but traces are empty. examples: req=8a3f2c9a, req=8a3f2d44. report attached (screenshots + timeline).
support_olivia: repro timeline — around 2026-03-16T21:10Z they saw a latency spike, then many traces with 0 spans in traceview.
eng_dan: can you paste one full request id and approximate timeframe? also which dataset/org id?
support_olivia: org: tenant-alpha (org_9821). example request id: 8a3f2c9a. timeframe: 2026-03-16T21:08:00Z -> 21:18:00Z. customer curl of the API returned 502 at 21:12 and logs show 3 spans emitted for same request id.
sre_mono: tagging here — ingestion pipeline had a rolling restart ~21:05Z yesterday for a config deploy. ingest-bot: restart event: ingestor-02 restarted (kube) 2026-03-16T21:04:47Z, reason: configmap reload.
eng_dan: that restart could explain transient drop, but if spans were emitted we should still link. any chance request-id header was mutated by proxy? got any example headers from the app?
support_olivia: customer supplied headers: 
    X-Request-ID: 8a3f2c9a
    Redwood-Trace-ID: (none)
They use our recommended flow (X-Request-ID only).
product_emma: UI question — are we sure this is a backend ingestion/linking issue and not a UI join problem (request-id -> trace id mapping on frontend)?
sre_mono: quick sanity check: when ingestion restarts, indexing window sometimes dropped for ~30s resulting in span documents being written after trace index writes. if UI joins on trace document existing first, that could surface as empty trace until re-index.
eng_dan: please run these lookups for one id:

Elasticsearch/ES query (replace index):

curl -s -XGET 'https://es.re.redwood/_search?q=tags.request_id:8a3f2c9a&size=20' | jq '.hits.total, .hits.hits[]._source.event_type'

and trace index lookup:

curl -s -XGET 'https://es.re.redwood/_search?q=trace.request_ids:8a3f2c9a&size=1' | jq '.hits.total'

eng_dan: expected: spans=3, trace-doc=1. observed: spans=3, trace-doc=0 -> join fails.
support_olivia: ran the queries for the customer: spans query returned 3 hits, trace lookup returned 0.
eng_dan: ok that matches a late-indexing / index write-order problem. do we have any recent PRs touching trace aggregation or the document keying?
sre_mono: PR #3341 touched aggregator batching: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/3341 — it changed how trace docs are upserted (switched from id:trace_<hash> to id:trace_<gen-hash>). rolling deploy yesterday 20:58Z. ingest-bot: deploy record https://deploys.internal/2026-03-16/3341 (succeeded).
product_emma: if the trace id hashing changed we might fail to find traces by request_id because trace doc uses new key but UI query still expects the old one. is the UI using the trace id or a request_id-based ES join?
eng_dan: UI queries trace index by request_id field (trace.request_ids). That field should be present on the trace doc. If trace doc was created with different schema key or delayed, join fails.
support_olivia: customer still impacted. can we surface a short-term fix?
eng_dan: immediate mitigation: reindex recent span docs to regenerate trace documents for the missing window. I can run a backfill for 2026-03-16T20:50 -> 21:30 for tenant-alpha. prepping script: 

python scripts/backfill_traces.py --org org_9821 --start '2026-03-16T20:50:00Z' --end '2026-03-16T21:30:00Z' --dry-run

eng_dan: running dry-run now, will report counts.
sre_mono: watch cluster write load — reindexing that window for a tenant could spike indexing. throttling needed.
eng_dan: dry-run output: would recreate 72 trace docs, 68 of them currently missing trace.request_ids entries (i.e., spans present, trace doc absent).
product_emma: please notify customer about planned backfill and ETA. also ask whether they need data exported.
support_olivia: pinged customer with plan: backfill in 30m window, ETA 2h, will confirm when complete. they asked for visibility into root cause — please include the ingest deploy change.
eng_dan: performing backfill now with --throttle 50. I'll post progress.
eng_dan: progress: 25/72 trace docs recreated, no write errors.
sre_mono: monitor indexing latency and bulk queue depth:
kubectl -n ingest top pod ingestor-0
watch -n 1 'curl -s http://monitoring/reindex/queue | jq .depth'
eng_dan: backfill complete: 72/72 traces recreated. verified UI now shows spans for sample request ids (8a3f2c9a returns 3 spans).
eng_dan: root cause summary: PR #3341 changed upsert key generation and rolling deploy caused a short period where trace-aggregator produced trace docs without the request_ids field populated consistently. spans continued to land, but trace doc indexing was either delayed or created with new schema missing the request_ids field. caused UI join to return empty traces.
product_emma: next steps: revert or patch aggregator to populate request_ids invariantly, add integration test for key stability, and add a monitor that alerts when spans exist without trace-docs for >1m.
sre_mono: opened incident ticket INC-2026-045 and linked PR rollback plan.
eng_dan: created PR #3355 to restore stable key and added test.
support_olivia: customer notified, they confirmed traces visible and are happy with remediation. closing loop after postmortem. :thumbsup:
ingest-bot: alert cleared for ingest restart window. :white_check_mark:
product_emma: assigning postmortem to eng_dan + sre_mono. target postmortem draft ETA 2026-03-19. :eyes:
